paper.title: A Practical Guide to Resonance Frequency Assessment for Heart Rate Variability Biofeedback
paper.claim: Implements a generated, descriptive response curve across the exact six paced-breathing rates currently shared by the Brainstem mobile apps.
paper.population: The public papers do not validate a Brainstem device or population; this package contains generated participants only.
paper.referenceStandard: Two checksum-pinned CC-BY protocol sources plus a deterministic participant-grouped generated R-R fixture.
paper.relationEvidence: The public source audit pins the stepped protocol and its respiration, adherence, and artifact boundaries. The package independently recomputes bounded time-domain measures and preserves all exact response ties.

classification.unit: one complete six-rate paced-breathing session under the frozen generated contract

compatibility.brainstemContract: generated six-rate curve with final 120-second R-R windows; no production upload contract exists
requiredSignals: final 120 seconds of raw R-R intervals per rate
compatibility.window: Each rate is assigned for 180 seconds. Analyze only the final 120 seconds, in descending 0.5 cycles-per-minute steps from 7.0 to 4.5.
compatibility.preprocessing: Reject incomplete, reordered, short, overlong, non-finite, implausible, or augmented trials; recompute mean heart rate, RMSSD, and SD1; preserve every exact largest-RMSSD tie; aggregate each participant once.
mismatches: Neither current mobile app uploads one versioned complete six-rate curve.
Brainstem assigns pacing but does not measure respiration, adherence, or respiratory volume.
No repeated-session Brainstem evaluation establishes response-curve stability.
The paper protocols inspect artifacts and use additional physiological signals that are absent from this generated contract.

cohort.output: Generated participant-equal aggregate quartiles across six rates; no subject, session, raw R-R, adherence, respiration, or diagnostic rows.

personal.output: Generated owner-only session and median curves with all exact largest-observed-RMSSD ties preserved.
